Guides / 08—08

Make an auditable packaging plan

Keep dimensions, cushioning choices and service rules together before creating a label.

Vijeron · Updated 10 October 2026

Identify item and box

Write down item dimensions, planned per-side clearance, box inner dimensions and the reason for its orientation. Date the note so it does not get confused with an earlier packing version.

Measure after closing

Record the packed parcel's three outside sides and actual mass. Calculate volume, longest side, girth and dimensional weight only if the service divisor is known.

Test and verify

Physically test the cushioning; verify the divisor, rounding rules, shape limits and price in the carrier's official service. Keep the relevant terms link or document with the result.

Worked example

Example note: object 20 × 15 × 10 cm; clearance 2 cm/side; need 24 × 19 × 14 cm; box inner size 25 × 20 × 15 cm; measure outside after closing.

Watch out

Do not keep only a dimensional-weight figure without the dimensions, divisor and date of the rule behind it.
